label: Polo
aesthetic: Ivy prep: OCBD or polo, chinos/cords/grey trousers, loafers, navy blazer; cable knits for cold.
signature_pieces: penny, tassel or suede loafer, clean white leather sneaker
navy blazer, tweed/plaid sport coat, field jacket

min_signals.why: at least 2 of: prep top, prep bottom, prep shoe

banned.why: Mules (Faloni), fashion sneakers and dad/suede runners (ALD) are off-brand.
Resort, fashion and work shirts belong to other houses.
No distressed/frayed denim-workwear finishes or track pants.
A trucker belongs to RRL/ALD; a toggle parka to ALD.

pairing_rules.why: Boots only with an OCBD or cable/crew knit, never with a work shirt (RRL).
Boot + jean = RRL. With boots, wear chino, cord or wool.
A denim shirt is only Polo under a blazer or sport coat.
A blazer or field jacket is preferred in cool weather.
Collegiate knits go with sneakers or plain loafers.

weekday.modifier: OCBD/polo + chino or trouser + loafer; blazer preferred in fall/winter

weekend.modifier: Cable or polo + chino/jean + loafer/white sneaker

out.modifier: Navy blazer + OCBD + grey/cream trouser + loafer

card_note: Ivy prep: OCBD or polo, chinos or cords, loafers; navy blazer when cool.
gap_note: No boat shoes or true khaki chinos: beige/cream trousers stand in.

must_differ.rrl: Polo never uses the flannel/denim-shirt + jean + boot stack.
must_differ.italianwinter: Polo leads with OCBD/polo/cable and allows sneakers; IW needs a fine knit, wool trouser and a required jacket.
must_differ.faloni: No mules; lead top is OCBD/piqué/cable, not a knit polo tucked into linen.

scoring.empty_state: Polo always has looks for Joe; if a color/season combo empties it, show the closest look failing only POLO-P5.

gaps: No boat shoe; no plate named 'oxford' (the button-ups/dress shirts are matched by the oxford_shirt signal).

bottom.name: Navy Blue/brown. Match Original Blue/brown. Match Original denim trousers

current_code_scoring: houses.ts Polo: required tokens (OCBD/polo/cable + chino/trouser + loafer) + forbidden set, used only by houseFingerprintOk/houseLegalCombo. lookFitsOccasion has NO polo branch and the row never calls the fingerprint, so the Polo row == All row in all 15 simulated contexts.

test_cases.desc: Light blue dress shirt + dark brown chinos + brown leather loafers + navy blazer
RRL stack in Polo: blue plaid flannel + navy denim + boots + chore
Light pink polo + cream trousers + brown suede mules (Faloni, not Polo)
